hold_reasoning: Every analyst desk is at hold, and no new thesis clears the bar. Of the four trade conditions, none applies today. (1) No new conviction-6+ entry: goldfinger, satoshi, both steady-eddies and sharp-shooter-usd are all hold at 6, and yolo-sapiens-eur's 3EUS.MI short waits for a close at or above 16.76 (verified 15.82). (2) No held thesis is broken. 4GLD.DE at 117.10 is right at cost and well above goldfinger's 112 break level. BTC-EUR at 67,637 is still above satoshi's 66.9k break, and the position is up about 16% on its 58,233 average, so a EUR exit now would trigger PFU on a thesis that has not failed. ALV.DE at 451.10 is above cost. AIR.PA (196.40 vs 206.15 average) and PHAG.L (USD 47.24) are drawdowns in a broad risk-off tape, not stops. (3) Tax hygiene: it is not December yet, so loss-harvesting AIR.PA/NVDA/PHAG.L waits for the year-end review. Nothing held is PRIIPs-blocked, and cash of EUR 221 is above the 150 floor. (4) No position is above the EUR 400 cap; BTC-EUR is the largest at 372. On a Nasdaq hedge: yolo-sapiens-usd's -3x QQQ thesis is coherent at 8/10, but my only Nasdaq exposure is NVDA at about EUR 221. Sized at 1/L for QQQS.L that is about EUR 74, below the EUR 250 minimum, so by Criterion 3 I place no hedge and do not round up. The SLB remainder (about EUR 0.15) costs more to sell than it is worth under the EUR 1.25 floor and would use a turnover slot for nothing. It stays on the list for a cleanup sale alongside a real trade later. Cash at EUR 221 is the edge into a market that has not yet found a base.
